record.name: NotebookLM
record.one_liner: An AI-powered research and notebook assistant by Google for generating insights and summaries from documents.
record.access_note: API access requires Gemini Notebook Enterprise subscription and enterprise cloud setup.
record.api_note: Covers notebook management tasks, sources, and sharing via Google Cloud REST endpoints.
record.blocker_note: API access requires an enterprise subscription and cloud identity setup.
